title: Exercise ECG
what: Your ECG is recorded while you walk on a treadmill or pedal an exercise bike. The effort is increased step by step.
why: To check if your heart gets enough blood during effort: for chest pain when walking, after a stent, or before sports.
duration: usually 30 to 60 minutes in the room; the exercise itself takes 8 to 15 minutes
tell_doctor: What medicines you take. The doctor may ask you to skip some heart medicines on the test day. Do not stop them on your own
If you have chest pain at rest, high blood pressure, or a recent heart attack
Joint or leg problems. The treadmill may not suit you

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Have a light meal 2 to 3 hours before. Do not come hungry, and do not overeat.

prepare.title: Coffee and smoking
prepare.text: No coffee, strong tea, or cigarettes for a few hours before the test.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: Sportswear and comfortable walking shoes. A towel and water.

steps: The doctor asks how you feel and checks your blood pressure
Pads are stuck on your chest, and a blood pressure cuff goes on your arm
You start walking slowly. Every few minutes the speed or slope goes up
Your blood pressure and ECG are recorded the whole time. The doctor is close by
The test stops when your pulse reaches the target, or if you feel unwell
You rest for a few minutes while the recording continues
feel: You will get tired, like after walking fast uphill. This is expected
Faster breathing and pulse are normal
after: You can usually go home after 10 to 15 minutes
The doctor explains the result the same day
red_flags: During the test: chest pain or pressure, strong shortness of breath, or dizziness. Tell the doctor right away
At home: chest pain that does not go away. Call emergency services

faq.a: The test is done under a doctor's watch and stopped at the first sign of a problem. The risks are small, but tell the doctor about chest pain right away.

reminders.text: Exercise ECG tomorrow. Get your sportswear, shoes, and medicine list ready.
Have a light snack now, then nothing more to eat before the test. No coffee or cigarettes.
